Knowhow / Commerce / A CRM that follows the lead, not the spreadsheet
COMMERCE · CASE STUDY

Has anybody already built a CRM for tracking leads on an e-commerce system?

Tracking e-commerce leads from first visit to first order.

The question

How do you know which shoppers are worth a personal follow-up before the sales team drowns in contacts?

The approach

Start from the store’s own events — cart, wishlist, repeat visit — and turn only a few of them into leads. Keep the pipeline to three stages a small team can actually review each morning.

The tradeoff

Fewer, richer leads mean some buyers are never contacted. In return the team trusts the list and acts on it, instead of exporting it to yet another spreadsheet.

What to take with you

Measure lead-to-order time and who closed it. A pipeline nobody opens is worse than no pipeline.
